honest_scope: Beating nearest-noun is trivial here (nearest is the attractor -> below chance); the HONEST discriminator is beating the FIRST-NOUN positional heuristic on the subject-not-first subset via LEARNED function-word structure. A first-noun collapse is MIDDLE (positional heuristic), not head-tracking. A HARD_PASS is a GREEN-LIGHT-PENDING-VET (arm-D attributes representation vs learner), never a self-declared CG. Real Linzen corpus; lexeme-free structural encoding.
